text.key: The base's user %@ differs from macUser %@ in your image flake's settings – set macUser to %@ in nix/local/settings.nix, or create the base again with %@.
text.text: The base's user alex differs from macUser sam in your image flake's settings – set macUser to alex in nix/local/settings.nix, or create the base again with sam.

help.key: The base's user gets this credential's user, full name and password; macOS images are built with it, so no password is ever asked.

intro.key: Creates your macOS base from the IPSW: the guest user from your credential, automatic login, SSH with your keys from ~/.ssh. No manual steps and no password to type; a missing IPSW is downloaded first.
